name: greenonion-product-images
description: Plan and generate coordinated marketplace listing images with GreenOnion.

interface.longDescription:
Amazon listing images from your product photo, right in ChatGPT.

Upload one to five product photos and get a complete Amazon listing image set:
- A white-background Amazon main image
- Product infographics and feature callouts that sell your key benefits
- Lifestyle images that show the product in use
- Dimension graphics, close-up details and comparison charts
- Image text in English or another language you choose

Up to nine images in one matching style, so your whole listing looks like one brand.

You stay in control. Give exact wording and scenes, or let GreenOnion decide. Change any image before it's made.

2K images, saved to your GreenOnion project to edit later or download as a ZIP.

For Amazon sellers, brand owners, and the designers and agencies who make listing images. The images also work for other online stores.

Good to know:
- Sign in to a GreenOnion account. Generating images uses your account credits.
- Check text and claims in the images before you publish.
- GreenOnion is not affiliated with Amazon.
defaultPrompt: Make a full Amazon listing image set from this product photo.
Turn my product's selling points into Amazon infographics.
What can GreenOnion make from my product photo?

publication.release_notes: Clearer listing: Amazon listing images in the subtitle, a fuller description of what the plugin makes and how it works, new starter prompts, and availability beyond the United States.
